name: Double-faced tokens — the playable side supplies type line, P/T and text
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py (34 cards with 'power is null on a creature'). Scryfall layout double_faced_token keeps type line, P/T, colours and oracle text on card_faces only; _resolveCardFace had no branch for it, so the combined type line ('Token Creature — Angel // Token') was parsed and P/T stayed null. It now resolves the requested face, or the playable one when the requested face is a bare 'Token' back or a 'Card' helper. Angel // Angel is a 4/4 Angel; City's Blessing // Elemental (face 0 is 'Card') is the 0/1 Elemental; Goblin // Soldier added as face 1 is the white Soldier, then switched to the red Goblin; Incubator // Phyrexian says 'Transform this artifact', so it flips rather than being a choice.
